# Siddhant Vishnu

> Applied AI engineer (age 21) in Pune, India. I build AI agents and the evals that prove they work. Currently building Mirage, a Chrome extension that edits any website from plain English, and finishing Computer Engineering at PICT (Class of 2027). Previously intern, then Lead Engineer, then Product Manager at Froncort.AI (Mar 2025 – Sep 2026). Open to applied AI engineering roles from early 2027.

## About

- Pattern: enters unfamiliar domains, learns from first principles, and ships useful systems before the opportunity is obvious to most people.
- Operating principles: learn by entering; talk to the users; direction over code (in the AI era, deciding what to build is the bottleneck, so set the direction first, before building); distribution is the product.
- Recognition: 16VC Summer Founder Fellowship; selected for YC Startup School India (April 2026); 1st place at the IIT Bombay TechFest AI Quest hackathon (Dec 2024); 2nd place at Cummins IndoVateAI 2025; a short-form post that reached 600K views.

## Work

- Froncort.AI (healthcare AI, Mar 2025 – Sep 2026): intern to Lead Engineer to Product Manager in about 12 months; led up to 9 engineers across 3 enterprise healthcare-AI products.
  - RegDoc: FDA and EU MDR-aligned domain agents that turn thousands of source documents into compliance-ready regulatory documents, cutting documentation from weeks to minutes.
  - AI NETRA: TB outbreak prediction and diagnostic allocation, built with FIND and supported by Google.org; demoed at the India AI Impact Summit 2026. Built the analytics agent and led field validation with government TB officials (55.2% less screening effort, 54.8% lower cost).
- Mirage (co-founder, May 2026 – present): a Chrome extension that edits any website from plain English, with a verified agent pipeline and a held-out release gate. Live on the Chrome Web Store with about 100 users and a 400-person waitlist.
- VACHAN: finds the wet-waste promises Pune housing projects made to the government (735 tonnes a day across 1,214 projects) in 1,000+ public PDFs, shows the exact page, and drafts a letter asking for the plant to run. Built on AWS Bedrock, Step Functions and Textract.
- hackathon-playbook (open source): a win-first process for judged build competitions, from idea lock to demo video and submission. https://github.com/SidTheKid-dotcom/hackathon-playbook
- Other builds: MercuryAI (enterprise knowledge RAG), Urban Eye AI (city cameras that detect traffic, crowds and garbage, then alert by phone call), Oasis (campus social network, 1,200+ users), Steal or Share (real-time game-theory game for 200+ players), sid.breaks.prod (distribution experiment, 0 to 1,000 followers in 6 weeks).
